format.unknown: Format not confirmed for {state}. Using {q} questions, {p} to pass, as a practice format.
format.disagree: Sources disagree on the format in some states. Check at your RTO.
format.rto: In {state} the LL test is taken at the RTO. This practice uses the same question style; the screen there may look different.
format.deviceNote: Without the server, a practice exam uses practice questions and is scored on this phone as a practice result.

guided.title: Guided run
guided.finish: Got it, start a practice exam

timer.title: The timer
timer.body: Some states time each question. When the timer reaches 0 the test moves on by itself. Your state's format says if there is one.

pick.title: Pick and change an answer
pick.body: Tap an answer to pick it. To change it, tap another one before you press Next.

next.title: Next and Submit
next.body: Next takes you to the next question. On the last question the button says Submit, which ends the test.

timeout.title: If time runs out
timeout.body: When a question's time runs out, the test moves to the next question and that question counts as blank.

result.title: The result
result.body: At the end you see your score and the pass mark, then the questions to practise.

device.title: The device check
device.body: On the real test site, a camera check runs before the test. That happens on Sarathi, not here: this simulator never uses your camera. Keep the camera on there and don't refresh the page.

result.title: Practice exam result
result.provisional: Practice result scored on this phone. It counts for practice only.
result.guess: How many did you think you got?
result.guessNote: You thought {g}, you got {r}. Noticing the gap is how calibration improves.
result.colour: If you have a colour-vision condition, see what the medical rules say in Help.
result.missing: This result isn't on this phone.
result.label: Practice and familiarisation, not certification.
